What I could and couldn't confirm:

- **Biodôme and Insectarium:** Espace pour la vie's own schedule page was the only one I could open. 
It showed 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. for both in the week of October 12, 2026.
 That is an autumn week, not your dates. A listings site shows the winter pattern as 
Monday closed, Tuesday to Sunday 9:00–17:00, Dec 24 and 25 closed
. That would make Monday, Dec 28 a closed day, but I couldn't check it on the venue's own page.
- **Science Centre:** The Centre's own holiday-hours pages are from earlier years. They show it open 
10am to 6pm from December 26 to December 30
 in one year, and 
10 a.m. to 5 p.m., December 26 to 30
 in another. A listings site shows 
Dec 27 to Dec 30, 10:00–17:00
. I couldn't find the Centre's own 2026 posting, so check its site before you go.
- **Booking:** I found no reliable source for ticket prices or timed-entry rules, so I haven't listed any. Holiday days are likely to be busy, so check whether the Biodôme and Insectarium need advance tickets.

I didn't search for zoos, aquariums or playgrounds, so there are no picks for those.
